implementationStatus: The original comparison's actual initial, moving and settled renderings were inspected. Work really moved, but the dinner anchor faded when keyed DOM siblings were reordered; source now keeps a stable sibling order, highlights the extra split segment, removes repeated labels/details and renders narrow support intervals as lighter bands. The first keyboard trial preserved the draft but appended machine-generated prose; that observed design is superseded by a separately typed, editable condition on the existing time-block selection. Its normal host selection result was read back with the original source/object, date, timezone, 90-minute duration and non-executing hypothetical status. The refined rendering, stable-anchor motion, new condition chip/pointer interaction, narrow layout and explicit continuous/split comparison await current visual/runtime evidence. The image is a synthetic design reference, not a product screenshot.
